create_PointCloudOptimizer: create a PointCloudOptimizer instance to optimize a global scene from pairwise image observations
run_forward_loss: run the forward method on PointCloudOptimizer to compute the alignment loss between projected and predicted points
preset_camera_poses: preset known camera poses on the optimizer to fix them during optimization
get_3d_points: get the reconstructed 3D point clouds from depthmaps and camera intrinsics using get_pts3d
compute_focal_range: compute the acceptable focal length range for given image dimensions using acceptable_focal_range
